mapper.insert: insert into product (product_name, category_id, price, image, description, create_time, update_time, status, stock, low_stock_threshold) values (#{productName}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{stock}, 100), COALESCE(#{lowStockThreshold}, 10))
mapper.delete:

mapper.select: select d.*, c.name as categoryName from product d left outer join category c on d.category_id = c.id where d.stock <= d.low_stock_threshold order by (d.stock - d.low_stock_threshold) asc, d.stock asc, d.update_time desc
